SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, min(calendar_date) d0, max(calendar_date) d1, count(*) n, min(fiscal_week_start_date) ws, max(fiscal_week_end_date) we
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctrl_net, SUM(CASE WHEN c.store_id=999 THEN c.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS ctrl_999
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT w.*, c.ctrl_net, c.ctrl_999, w.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS gap FROM weekly w JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       SUM(c.net_sales) AS net, SUM(c.receipts) AS receipts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.store_id) AS stores
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales c ON c.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week IN (7,8)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_rl,
       min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT store_id, store_name, open_date, close_date, valid_from, valid_to, is_current FROM dim_store
WHERE close_date IS NOT NULL OR open_date >= DATE '2024-04-01' ORDER BY store_id

WITH s AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_week=5 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND c.net_sales<>0 AND business_date IN (DATE '2025-05-27', DATE '2026-06-02')
)
SELECT store_id, max(CASE WHEN business_date=DATE '2025-05-27' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ly, max(CASE WHEN business_date=DATE '2026-06-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ty,
  any_value(st.store_name) nm
FROM s LEFT JOIN dim_store st USING (store_id) GROUP BY store_id HAVING ly<>ty ORDER BY 1

SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_week, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
